description_excerpt: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Are you ready to shape the future with confidence? About the opportunity The FSO team at EY Vietnam supports banks and financial institutions in: • Risk analysis and risk management (credit, fraud, operational, etc.) • Regulatory reporting and compliance • Financial data analytics • AML / Anti-fraud • Applying AI & Machine Learning in banking We are looking for…
benefits: Training and direct mentoring from experts
Participation in real projects with banks and financial institutions
Opportunity to become a full-time employee after the internship
Professional, dynamic working environment with long-term development orientation
